title: Dad Full body
author: Roberto  B.
desc:
This program allows to hit each muscle 2 or 3 times per week, focusing on performance and progressive overload with a low-mid weekly volume base.
It's tailored to my needs and after some weeks I would adjust priority for target my weakness.
For the abs, I do them on rest days so there are not shown.

ex.note: Two top sets here. For the first one do no more than 8 reps with rope 9, it must be. If you fail at reach 8 keep same weight, instead increase an try to do 6 hard reps.
Dynamic double progression here, when you hit 8 reps increase weight for that set.
Pump the blood to the pecs, do every rep with mini pause to the stretch position and flex hard to the top. Slow down and controlled.
If you can do more than 10 pull up add weight. If you want you can swap this for a classic lat pulldown. Chest up and tight your abs, imagine to pull your elbows down and not rear.

Squeeze when you reach full contraction. Imagine to pull your elbows behind you while keeping torso straight. Hands and elbow always in line, don't close the angle.
Do a final drop set.
First set rpe8 9, second set increase weight and do your best. If you're motivated do the third set.
Double progression.
Keep weight untill you can do 3 sets for 10 reps.
Same story.
Hand, elbow and shoulder to the same line. Hit traps and upper back.

Control every phase of the rep. Squeeze hard at the top. First set don't fail, second and third max effort.
Use the machine if you want.
Increase weight only when you hit 12 reps in every set.

Ramping up to a weight for 10 hard reps and do 2 sets. Rest 2 to 3 minutes.
Increase only when you hit 10 reps for all the sets.

Ramp up to a 8RM an then follow with a back off set with -15% weight x max reps
3 min rest

Leg extension or sissy squat here.
15 rm
High reps 60 sec rest.
Double progression
Two top sets and one back off. Increase weight when you hit 8 reps for the first reotand 12 for the last.
Use weight. Or do 3 x max reps

Go heavy.
Stretch at the bottom and keep the tension for 2 to 3 seconds.
First set don't fail. The second is your top set, do it heavy and controlled and no more than 8 reps.
Heavy weight, control every rep. If you feel you can do more reps on last set, go on and see if you can beat the log.
Top set 1 rep shy failure and second increase weight and go all out.
Control and contract the muscle.

ss.note: Add weight only if you can do more than 8 reps on last set.
